Author: kaldigo
Name: Accord
Description: Configures the compatible Wrathful Combo engine through its settings API and manages static/live hotbars. Includes compact PvE/PvP layouts, three-bar manual logout fallback with login restoration, and automatic Sprint conversion on active hotbars. Development preview.
Punchline: Reviewed intent settings and matching hotbars.
Changelog: Validated source update. Development preview; native acceptance remains separate.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherworks
Description: Teleport home while Return is on cooldown, sync shared hotbars between PvE and PvP, and withdraw saddlebag stacks while leaving one for easy duplicate entrusting. Each feature is independently enabled.
Punchline: Paid Return fallback, shared hotbar sync and saddlebag conveniences.
Changelog: 0.2.1.2: Add Saddlebag Withdraw All but One, disabled by default under Items and storage. Right-click a saddlebag stack of two or more to withdraw its quantity minus one, retaining a copy for Pandora's Entrust Duplicates matching. Covers regular and premium saddlebag tabs, preserves HQ/NQ, and checks the source and native quantity dialog before one submission. Keeps Return via Teleport and Shared Hotbar Sync. Native in-game acceptance remains pending.

Author: NightmareXIV, kawaii
Name: AutoRetainer
Description: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Punchline: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Changelog:
Fix the Steward collection sweep stalling at the retainer list: reuse AutoRetainer’s existing decoded retainer list and selector instead of converting a native byte span to text. Log retainer selection steps. Publish the previously tested companion storage/gil-only boundaries, optional strategy coordination, GC-first disposal priority and shared demo-mode guard for GC delivery, desynthesis and selling. Native retainer selection remains unchanged. Original plugin identity and upstream functionality are preserved. In-game collection acceptance remains pending.

Steward decision-review integration: optional collection sweep reuses existing retainer postprocessing; read-only disposal selection shares the original hard-list predicate and enabled methods. Original identity, recoloured icon, workflows and protocol-6 safety gates remain unchanged. Paired Steward update intended for log-only decision validation; native execution acceptance remains pending.

Protocol 6 storage preview: optional companion-owned overflow pass reuses bell/retainer/postprocess workflows and native entrust command. Exact per-item Store bridge, unique/space guards and destination acknowledgements retain pending review on uncertainty. Original identity, icon and existing functionality remain unchanged. Native acceptance pending.

Repeated safety review: protocol 5 and an independent synchronous policy ledger replace the incorrect assumption that EzConfig writes propagate disk failures. Managed NPC/retainer sales, desynthesis and armoire storage journal before submission and require exact acknowledgement; remaining jobs wait. Ordinary config imports cannot remove ownership. Review/detach reject backlogged work. Withdrawal binds retainer/HQ and pause managers retain pending transaction guards. Original identity and workflows remain. Native acceptance and safe cross-zone collection refresh are still pending.

Author: kaldigo; based on MidoriKami's ExpandedHotbars
Name: ExpandedHotbars Plus
Description: Create hotbars of any size, spacing, and keybinds, with functions to show and hide these bars dynamically.
Punchline: Add and control an unlimited number of custom additional hotbars.
Changelog: Validated fork update from source e99e068923f94a8c24842b710a024cb8a2b4a51a. Build, configuration, merge-policy and package checks passed. Preserves the fork's auto-close and icon customizations. Development preview; native UI acceptance testing remains separate.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Steward
Description: Collection-aware inventory decisions and market rules coordinated with the AutoRetainer integration fork. Starts in dry-run mode.
Punchline: Collect what matters. Sell the surplus.
Changelog:
Fix decoded retainer names in storage progress labels and keep the window closed on startup/reload. Publish the previously tested collection/storage exclusions, persistent protection handling, disposal-route logging, turnover-based sale rotation, optional dedicated dye strategy, and confirmed-empty-market Universalis-average fallback. Requires AutoRetainer storage capability 3 for automatic execution. Existing feature settings are preserved; no automation is enabled by this update. In-game collection acceptance remains pending.

Replace category checkboxes with clickable icon buttons: blue highlights for selected categories and amber borders for partial saved selections. Use combined category names and counts in selected summaries. Hide Soul Crystals from the picker and exclude them from Select all. Preserve existing rule scope, four marketboard-style groups, whole-group controls and wrapped icon rows. No automation or protection policy changes.

Author: kaldigo; based on Team Wrath's Wrath Combo
Name: Wrath Combo
Description: Wrath rotation engine fork with configurable continuation, targeting and support functionality. Configured independently or through its settings API. Accord-compatible build. Replaces stock Wrath Combo; remove the legacy WrathFork installation before loading.
Punchline: Configurable Wrath rotation engine and settings API.
Changelog: Validated source update. Development preview; native acceptance remains separate.
